armor-encumbrance-hint: Enc % of the worn armor pieces that still protect: it penalizes Essence and Channeling spells
armor-weight-hint: Lighter: less DB; heavier: more DB and cost
campaign-elapsed-days-warning: Changing the elapsed days only corrects the calendar: it does not heal or rest anybody. To make time pass with its effects, use «Pass time» in the campaign view.
campaign-start-date-help: Free text, in the calendar of your world: "3 Víressë, 1640 T.A.", "First day of the thaw"…
cart-direct-total-hint: Price without haggling; the next step lets you haggle.
cart-empty-hint: Pick items from the catalog to add them
character-dead-alert: This character is dead. Its injuries can no longer be treated.
checkout-cart-hint: Review the lines and amounts before choosing how to buy.
checkout-method-direct-hint: Pay the catalog price, with no roll.
checkout-method-negotiated-hint: Market conditions and a Trading roll, following the rulebook.
checkout-negotiated-percent: Trading total {{total}}: {{percent}}% of the expected price
checkout-no-deal-hint: nothing will be charged. Go back to change the roll or buy directly.
checkout-whole-cart-hint: The conditions and the roll apply to the whole cart, as if every item had the same features. To treat an item apart, buy it apart.
coat-item-help: Spends one dose. A liquid lasts an hour and a paste a week; the next hit in a tactical game spends it and a critical exposes the target.
coat-item-no-poisons: No liquid or paste poison in this inventory
craft-enhancements-hint: Bonuses the game master grants to the new item, such as +5 to attacks.
craft-no-craftsman: The faction has no characters to work as craftsmen
craft-quality-materials-unavailable: The superior materials need Core Law access: the item is crafted of standard material
craft-quality-no-materials: This item takes no superior material
craft-roll-hint: A failure wastes the materials; a better result makes a sturdier item.
culture-creation-help: Optional. The culture ranks are applied before level 1 without spending development points.
discard-item-confirm: {{name}} (× {{amount}}) will be thrown away. The ledger keeps a record of it.
dodge-encumbrance-hint: Beast of Burden does not lower the encumbrance penalty of the dodge
enchantment-adjust-hint: Extra days and cost of the failures. The extra cost is charged to the payer.
enchantment-batch-hint: A batch takes the same days and materials for every unit; the spells cast per unit cost their PP for each one
enchantment-batch-whole-stack: The whole stack is enchanted ({{count}} units)
enchantment-confirm-cancel: The materials of the days not worked are refunded to the payer.
enchantment-confirm-complete: The item gets its enchantment, its modifiers and its new value.
enchantment-confirm-delete: The project is deleted; the item and the history stay as they are.
enchantment-failure-rolls-pending: Roll the failures of the failed spells before going on
enchantment-item-hint: Choose the item to enchant. Enchanted items and items of another active project are not listed.
enchantment-labor-cost-hint: Value of the work of the alchemist: part of the price, nobody pays it
enchantment-material-reduction-hint: Days less for the bonus of a superior material, down to half
enchantment-no-alchemist: There is no character to enchant the item
enchantment-no-items: There is no item to enchant
enchantment-paid-at-start-hint: The materials, with the power level
enchantment-payer-hint: Who pays the materials, at the start
enchantment-power-level-hint: It multiplies the cost of the enchantment, not the base item
enchantment-ready: Every day is worked: the enchantment can be completed
enchantment-scr-hint: One open-ended roll per spell for the whole process. A total of 0 or less fails, and the failure is rolled in the table of the spell.
enchantment-spells-hint: Spells of the grimoire of the alchemist, the alchemical ones first. At least one must be alchemical. A doubled scope costs twice the days and PP; a halved one, half.
enchantment-target-required: Choose the skill of each skill bonus
enchantment-warning-pp-per-day-above-cha: The PP per day are more than the power points of the alchemist
equip-no-options: No item of the character fits this slot
faction-npcs-empty: The faction has no NPCs: guards, mercenaries, mounts or pets.
faction-players-help-master: Only players of the game can be in a faction. Its players change the faction, its characters and their equipment.
faction-players-help-player: You can add your friends: if they are not in the game, they join it as players.
faction-players-no-candidates: There are no more players in the game
fighting-style-not-found: This style is not in the catalog
game-member-add-help: Only friends of the owner of the game can join it.
game-members-none: Nobody else plays in this game yet.
game-option-allow-saving-dev-points-help: Lets characters keep their unspent normal development points for the next level when they level up. Off by default: the points must be spent or are lost.
game-option-base-dev-points-help: Development points each character gets per level to spend on skills. More points mean more versatile characters.
game-option-board-scale-help: Converts distances to the scale of the board or map, so movements show in board units. 1 means feet as in the book.
game-option-bonus-dev-points-cap-at-crea: Applies the per-level limit of bonus development points also to the talents bought at creation, so they cannot all go into one level.
game-option-creation-bonus-dev-points-he: Extra development points the game master gives at creation, added to the race's.
game-option-experience-multiplier-help: Multiplies the experience the characters earn. Above 1 they level up faster; below 1, slower.
game-option-fatigue-multiplier-help: Multiplies the fatigue that combat actions build up. Higher values call for endurance rolls sooner; 0 turns combat fatigue off.
game-option-intense-training-help: With the game master's permission, one skill per level may take more than two ranks, each extra rank at the second cost. Not for a skill that already has ranks equal to twice the level (lores and languages are exempt from that limit). Off by default.
game-option-knack-bonus-help: Bonus each knack adds to its skill.
game-option-knack-count-help: How many skills of its profession a character can mark as knacks.
game-option-letality-help: A bonus added to every attack of the campaign. Positive values make combat deadlier; negative ones, more forgiving.
game-option-max-trait-cost-help: Most a single talent can cost at creation. Lower values keep out the most powerful talents.
game-option-open-rounds-help: An action not resolved by the end of the round carries over to the next one, keeping the action points spent. Off, unfinished actions are lost when the round ends.
game-option-power-level-preset-help: Fills the stat, knack and power point values of the power level from the table of the rules. The values stay editable; the preset is kept as a label of the game and is the default power level of the market and of enchantments.
game-option-pp-recovery-percent-help: Percent of the maximum power points recovered every 2 hours of rest, up to 4 periods a day. Talents that change the sleep only change the length of the period. Default: {{default}}%.
game-option-race-dev-points-per-level-he: Most bonus development points (of the race and the game master) a character can spend in a single level.
game-option-starting-wealth-help: Wealth category of the new characters: when a character is created in the game it gets the silver pieces of its category per starting level as gold coins in its purse. Level 0 characters get nothing. Off by default.
game-option-stat-boost-potential-help: Potential value a stat gets when a creation boost raises it to the average.
game-option-stat-boost-temporary-help: Temporary value a stat gets when a creation boost raises it to the average.
game-option-stat-creation-boosts-help: How many boosts a new character can apply to its stats: raising one to the average, raising the best ones, or extra gain rolls.
game-option-stat-creation-swaps-help: How many times a new character can exchange the values of two stats.
game-option-stat-generation-help: How the stats of a new character are generated.
game-option-stat-points-help: Budget to buy stats when they are generated by points instead of rolled.
game-option-stat-random-min-help: When stats are rolled, results below this value are rolled again. Higher values avoid very weak stats.
game-option-talent-policy-help: When and with which points talents can be bought.
game-option-talent-purchase-rules-help: Optional rules of the Character Companion: each tier of a talent needs one of its prerequisites (training and milestones are granted by the game master), a flaw must hinder the character and waits for approval when that cannot be checked, flaws taken with a talent are linked to it up to its cost, and only one loose flaw up to -20 DP is allowed. Off by default.
game-power-level-intro: How strong characters are when created: development points, how stats are generated and improved, and talents and knacks. The defaults are a heroic campaign.
game-realm-not-readable: The owner of the game can no longer read its realm: no new characters can be created and the players lose access to the realm.
game-settings-intro: Rules of the campaign: how fast characters advance, how deadly combat is and which optional rules apply. The info buttons explain each one.
game-visibility-private-help: Only the members of the game see it.
game-visibility-public-help: Anybody sees its cover and can ask to join; only members see its content.
gem-cut-fee-hint: 10 % of the new value, charged to the holder
gem-set-no-gems: This holder has no loose gems
healing-choose-healer-first: Choose the healer in the first step.
healing-log-rest: Rest {{hours}} h, {{days}} days: hits {{before}} → {{after}}, injuries -{{counter}} days
healing-tables-unavailable-preview: The healing tables are not available: the type of healing modifier is left out of the preview.
health-injuries-help: Active injuries and their total penalty. Details on the character sheet.
herb-search-base: Roll {{roll}}, bonus {{bonus}}: base {{base}} before the modifiers of each herb
herb-search-no-herbs: No herb of the catalog grows in this biome
herb-search-no-skill: The character has not developed this skill.
herb-search-result: {{doses}} doses found in {{hours}} hours, added to the inventory
herb-search-rules-hint: Absolute maneuver with the Find difficulty of each herb, −10 per previous search and the penalty for several herbs. The season is not checked: the game master decides.
herb-search-several-hint: Several herbs: −{{value}} to the first one, cumulative for each next one.
herb-use-no-items: The character carries no herb that heals hits.
jewelry-value-rolled-hint: Without a base value, the server rolls it in the range of the type.
join-game-help: This game is public: you only see its cover. Ask to join and a game master will answer.
join-request-pending: Your request to join is waiting for a game master.
ledger-outcome-cannot-fix-broken: Not enough to fix a broken item
ledger-outcome-halved: Half of the damage was fixed
ledger-outcome-jury-rigged-working: Patched up: it works for now
ledger-outcome-wasted: The work failed and the materials are lost
load-percent-hint: Worn and carried weight in % of the body weight
manage-character-skills: Manage your character's skills and specializations.
market-conditions-hint: They set the expected price before haggling.
market-conditions-unavailable: The Treasure Law trading tables are not loaded: the Core Law Trading rule applies, with no market conditions.
masterwork-not-allowed: Only torso armor gets an armor bonus
missing-reference-help: It does not exist in this installation: it came with an imported character and has no effect
more-info-in-core-law: More info in section {{section}} of Core Law.
multilingual-language-ranks: Split {{total}} ranks between spoken and written ({{assigned}} assigned)
no-power-points: The character has no power points: develop Power Development.
no-spell-lists: The character has no spell lists.
no-start-date: No start date: you can set one by editing the campaign.
no-strategic-games-description: Create a campaign to start adding factions and characters.
no-tactical-games-have-been-created: No tactical games have been created
pass-time-consumption-notice_one: The character who lives through this time ({{time}}) must eat, drink and use up other supplies. Nothing is taken from the inventory: deduct it by hand.
pass-time-consumption-notice_other: Each of the {{count}} characters who live through this time ({{time}}) must eat, drink and use up other supplies. Nothing is taken from the inventory: deduct it by hand.
pass-time-no-characters: There are no living characters in the campaign: only the calendar will move.
payer-faction-hint: Spending faction gold needs the game master.
permanent-check-required: Doubles on the recovery roll: roll again for permanent injury.
permanent-injury-help: Roll after recovery to find out how much of the original injury penalty becomes permanent.
poison-rr-help: Leave the roll empty for the server to roll it. The RR adds the poison resistance of the sheet and the level of the poison.
price-quote-unavailable: The price cannot be worked out yet
professional-bonuses-add-skills: Add more skills of the profession to be able to choose them.
recovery-already-rolled: The recovery roll for the latest treatment is done. Treat the injury again to make another one.
recovery-days-explanation: The total of the roll picks a row of the recovery table, and the injury type its column. That is multiplied by the severity (and the head), then by the race and the Fast or Slow Healer talents.
recovery-multiplier-help: Race recovery multiplier x{{value}} (with talents): it multiplies the healing time.
recovery-untreated-help: Untreated injury (no treatment or a failed one): the recovery roll gets the worst healing modifier. The injury still improves over time, and whatever penalty remains at the end becomes permanent.
recovery-untreated-rolled: Recovery without care: when it ends, the remaining penalty becomes permanent. Make the permanent injury roll to settle how much stays.
rest-active-help: Travelling or working: hits only recover in {{hours}} hours of sleep of each whole day, untreated injuries do not improve and treated ones count each day once.
rest-help: Resting recovers {{percent}}% of the maximum hits every {{hours}} hours. Whole days count for the injuries; with complete rest each day counts x{{multiplier}}.
select-campaign-to-continue: Select the campaign the character will belong to.
sell-to-jeweler-hint: The jeweler pays the value less the commission, without haggling.
specialization-catalog-empty: The realm has no options: its owner adds them to the catalog.
starting-wealth-rate: {{sp}} sp per level, as gold coins
strenuous-failure-help: A strenuous activity failed while the injury recovered: it is active again, loses its recovery and needs a new treatment before the next recovery roll.
style-free-ranks-help: Ranks not allocated to abilities: +2 OB each, at most +10, while fighting in the style. Allocations are permanent.
talent-policy-flaw-points-at-creation-he: At creation talents can only be paid with the points returned by flaws, which go to their own pool instead of the normal points.
talent-policy-free-help: Talents are paid with normal development points first and then with bonus points, at creation and later.
talent-policy-help-flaw-points-at-creati: At creation, talents are paid only with the points the character's flaws give back.
talent-policy-help-free: Talents can be bought with any development points, at any level.
talent-policy-help-race-points-at-creati: New talents only at creation and only with bonus development points; later, only improvements of the ones the character has.
talent-policy-race-points-at-creation-he: At creation talents can only be paid with bonus development points; later only the talents already owned can be improved.
talent-ranks-breakdown: {{talent}} of the {{total}} ranks come from a talent
taxes-and-tolls-hint: Reference table: the game master applies them by hand.
taxes-unavailable: The taxes have not been imported.
trading-maneuver-hint: Roll Trading for the character; the merchant's total goes in its own field.
trading-merchant-hint: Optional: the merchant's roll is subtracted from 100 and added to the negotiator's.
trading-negotiation-hint: Roll Trading for the negotiator; the total gives the percent of the expected price in the negotiation table.
trait-link-help: A flaw among the Possible Flaws of a talent of the character; the linked flaws are worth at most the cost of the talent
trait-pending-approval-help: The game master has to confirm that this flaw hinders the character
trait-pending-approval-info: This flaw will wait for the approval of the game master.
trait-reason-choose-higher-tier: Already owned at tier {{tier}}: choose a higher tier
trait-reason-flaw-worsen-master: Only the game master can raise the tier of a flaw
trait-reason-max-cost: Costs {{cost}} DP and the campaign allows up to {{max}}
trait-reason-not-affordable: Not enough development points ({{available}} available, {{cost}} needed)
trait-reason-owned-max-tier: Already owned at its highest tier
trait-reason-prerequisite-unmet: A new tier does not meet any of the prerequisites of the talent
trait-restricted-help: Only acts in some situations: it costs half and its effects on the sheet are situational
trait-select-hint: Choose a trait from the list to see its details and cost.
trait-specialization-needed: Choose a specialization to add this trait.
transfer-gold-to-character: Move gold from the faction to the character
transfer-gold-to-faction: Move gold from the character to the faction
treatment-difficulty-default: The table has no entry for this injury: medium difficulty.
treatment-heat-critical: Cauterizing causes a heat critical of severity {{severity}}. Resolve it by hand.
treatment-herb-applied: {{name}}: {{medicine}} to Medicine, {{recovery}} to the recovery roll
treatment-herb-bonus-magical: {{medicine}} to Medicine and {{recovery}} to the recovery roll; one dose is spent.
treatment-herb-bonus-mundane: Mundane herb: {{medicine}} to Medicine, no recovery bonus; one dose is spent.
treatment-herb-generic: Without an item: the generic herbs option, no dose spent.
treatment-herb-none-carried: The character carries no herb that treats this injury.
treatment-herbalism-help: Herbalism bonus {{bonus}}. A success adds {{value}} to the Medicine roll.
treatment-herbalism-preview: The Herbalism bonus is added if that roll succeeds.
treatment-magic-help: Healing magic needs no Medicine roll.
xp-award-help: Use the base award and the game multiplier to calculate the final XP.
xp-base-required: Enter a base experience value greater than zero.
